editorial:
Imagine waking up with a weird lump on your back, only to find out it is actually a 400-year-old evil spirit trying to be born again. That is exactly what happens to the girlfriend of a psychic in this wild ride. The movie mixes old-school ghost stories with weird science, giving you a vibe that feels like a strange fever dream from the seventies. You will see a lot of bizarre scenes and a plot that does not take itself too seriously, which makes it a lot of fun to watch if you just want something crazy for a Friday night.

While the special effects look a bit dated now, the acting is surprisingly solid and the twists keep you guessing. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the sheer weirdness of the plot makes up for it. If you love campy horror, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends who like odd stories.
endingExplained: In the final act, the demonic spirit fully grows and takes over. The psychic and his team try to stop the monster using a mix of science and magic. They eventually manage to trap the evil spirit and destroy the physical body it was using to enter our world. The movie ends with the threat finally gone, though it leaves you wondering if such a powerful evil can ever truly be deleted for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves odd 70s horror and strange plot twists.
